description.value:
Prerequisites Local Instance

Traits Paradise-Touched

Your Local Instance lasts 10 minutes instead of 1 minute. In addition, once per minute you may change which rule it alters, choosing a new one as though you had just used it. Everything else about Local Instance is unchanged, including its Bandwidth cost, which is paid once when you use it and not again when you change the rule.

cinderfall.incomplete: Prerequisite Local Instance; extends its duration and lets you swap its chosen rule once/minute. Inherits `local-instance`'s own INCOMPLETE status (bucket 7, genuinely novel world-state overrides with no rule-element representation); this card only modifies an already-unbuildable ability.
